$comment: Runtimes, generation lanes, distribution rails and money rails the Alexandria swarm calls. These are not data providers: nothing here executes through the Alexandria transport. `status` is wired (credential name known, used in the estate today), planned (named in architecture, not yet wired), or evaluating (experiment open in experiments/registry.json). Credentials are env var NAMES only; values never enter this repo.

connectors.name: Claude managed agents (Anthropic)
connectors.role: Synthesis briefs, long-horizon research swarms, receipts-aware tool use. Default runtime for the Synthesis and Forge houses.
connectors.notes: Claude Code + Agent SDK already run the estate (STACK.md L3). Managed-agent sessions add server-side sandboxes and session persistence.

connectors.name: OpenAI Agents / Responses API
connectors.role: Second-opinion verification, structured-output extraction, Exchange-facing request handlers. Never the sole judge of a receipt.
connectors.notes: Foundry already preflights an OpenAI submission profile (tools/foundry/cli.mjs preflight-openai).

connectors.name: Gemini (Google)
connectors.role: Long-context corpus passes (Scribe), grounded search, multimodal reads of charts and filings.

connectors.name: OpenRouter
connectors.role: Default LLM route for volume work and model A/B inside experiments (machine-global policy).

connectors.name: Firecrawl (search, scrape, Alexandria execution)
connectors.role: The catalogued-data transport. Every firecrawl-alexandria provider in providers.json executes through it.

connectors.name: Higgsfield MCP
connectors.role: Image, video and consistent-character generation across 30+ models (Soul, Flux, Seedream, Kling, Hailuo, Veo, Sora). ACOS /studio default connector.

connectors.name: Seedance (ByteDance) video
connectors.role: Short-form video generation lane for creator pipelines; reached through Higgsfield or fal when exposed.

connectors.name: Veo (Google) video
connectors.role: Cinematic lane; Gemini-native prompting.

connectors.name: Kling video
connectors.role: Still-to-video and character-motion lane.

connectors.name: Nano Banana (Gemini image)
connectors.role: Search-grounded, text-legible hero and infographic images (scripts/nb-generate.mjs in FrankX).

connectors.name: Suno
connectors.role: Music catalog lane (Music IS composes here).

connectors.name: vidIQ MCP
connectors.role: YouTube and short-form analytics, outliers, publishing; the measurement side of the creator loop.

connectors.name: TikTok (via vidIQ Instagram/TikTok outlier search and manual publish)
connectors.role: Short-form distribution and outlier research. Publishing stays a human gate (FrankX hard stop on auto-distribute).

connectors.name: Postiz
connectors.role: Scheduled multi-platform social distribution behind the human publish gate.

connectors.name: Resend
connectors.role: Newsletter and receipt digests. Blasts are a hard stop requiring Frank.

connectors.name: Polar
connectors.role: Checkout, subscriptions and usage-metered billing for Exchange products (merchant of record).

connectors.name: Stripe
connectors.role: Managed payments for SaaS tiers when eligible (gencreator.ai ADR-010 preference).

connectors.name: x402 / AP2 agent payments
connectors.role: Pay-per-call rail for agents buying Exchange records. Verify-only through payment-intelligence-system; no autonomous money movement.
connectors.notes: Gated by payment-intelligence-system doctrine: fail-closed mandate verification, human gate above cap.

connectors.name: Vercel
connectors.role: Exchange API edge, previews, sandboxes for Forge runs.

connectors.name: Supabase
connectors.role: Receipt ledger at scale (Postgres + pgvector), entitlements, usage metering.

connectors.name: Cloudflare (Workers, R2, D1, KV)
connectors.role: Edge cache for receipts and pass-through responses; R2 for record snapshots.

connectors.name: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
connectors.role: GPU and credit-backed batch lanes for Scribe corpus passes; enterprise reference architecture. Independent project, not affiliated with Oracle.

connectors.name: GitHub
connectors.role: Source of truth for catalogue, experiments and receipts-in-repo; CI gates.

connectors.name: protocol/sign.mjs (proposed SIP graph extension)
connectors.role: Turns a declared receipt into a signed, re-checkable one (Ed25519/DSSE). Required before any receipt is resold on the Exchange.
